title: Friday Squid Blogging: EU is Trying to Fight Unregulated Squid Fishing
summary: The EU is recommending import controls to combat unregulated squid fishing in the Southwest Atlantic. I’m not optimistic. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
